note: Field Label has a global settings config (field_label.settings at route field_label.module_config_form) plus per-formatter-component third-party settings stored under field_label on entity_view_display config entities. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads a global setting value and reads a per-field label override on node.article.default; execution writes a label override / wrapper tag onto the body field's formatter component and is verified against the live entity_view_display. The default 'article' content type with a 'body' field exists on this site.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal contrib module field_label, how do I override the displayed label text of a single field on one view mode, and where is that override stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: On the entity's Manage display for that view mode, open the field's formatter settings (cog), expand 'Label settings', and set 'Label value'. It is stored as a third-party setting on that formatter component: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.field_label.label_value.

evals.prompt: field_label gates each of its label features behind a permission. Name the permissions and what determines whether a given label option (e.g. the wrapper tag or the class field) actually appears on the formatter settings form.
evals.expected_output: Permissions: edit_field_label_value, edit_field_plural_label, edit_field_label_class, edit_field_label_class_select, edit_field_label_tag. An option appears only when its global *_enabled flag in field_label.settings is TRUE AND the user holds the matching permission; otherwise the field is hidden (value preserved).

evals.prompt: After enabling field_label and choosing an HTML wrapper tag (e.g. h3) for a field label, the label still renders in the default element in my custom theme. Why, and what Twig change makes the wrapper tag take effect?
evals.expected_output: field_label exposes the chosen tag as the 'label_tag' Twig variable and only overrides the CORE field template. A theme that ships its own field*.html.twig must reference it, e.g. <{{ label_tag|default('div') }}{{ title_attributes }}>{{ label }}</{{ label_tag|default('div') }}>; otherwise the theme template wins and the tag is ignored (though text/classes still apply).

evals.prompt: On this site, field_label's global settings have been customized. Inspect the live field_label.settings configuration and report the contents of its 'class_list' setting (the label-class select list).
evals.expected_output: field_label.settings.class_list is '.fl-primary|Primary label' (and label_class_select_enabled is TRUE). Readable via drush config:get field_label.settings.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type's default display has a field whose label has been overridden using field_label. Inspect the live default view display for Article and report the overridden label text.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the 'field_fl_target' field component carries third_party_settings.field_label.label_value = 'FL Known Label'.

evals.prompt: On the Article content type's default view display there is a field with machine name 'field_fl_target' (label 'FL Target'). Use field_label to override that field's displayed label so it reads 'Story Body'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fl_target component gets third_party_settings.field_label.label_value = 'Story Body' (set via the component API or Manage display -> field_fl_target formatter -> Label settings -> Label value).

evals.prompt: On my site's Article default display there is a field 'field_fl_target' (label 'FL Target'). I want that field's label to be wrapped in an <h3> heading tag using the field_label module. Make that change on the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fl_target component gets third_party_settings.field_label.label_tag = 'h3' (h3 is one of the default allowed_tags). Set via the component API or Manage display -> field_fl_target -> Label settings -> Label wrapper.
